project_title: Gut microbiota of one-and-a-half-year-old food-allergic and healthy children
project_description: Case-control fecal 16S rRNA gut microbiota study of 29 food-allergic (FA) and 19 healthy (HC) one-and-a-half-year-old children, using LEfSe (LDA score > 2) to identify differentially abundant genera.
citation: Hara et al. 2024, Allergology International, PMID 38600019
notes: FA vs healthy children, age 1.5 years. LEfSe threshold LDA>2 stated in paper; exact per-taxon LDA scores not given in extractable text.

project_title: Gut microbiota signatures in food allergy children without and with malnutrition: a cross-sectional study
project_description: Cross-sectional case-control fecal 16S rDNA (V3-V4) gut microbiota study of 80 oral-food-challenge-diagnosed food-allergic children (40 with malnutrition [FAM], 40 without malnutrition [FANM]) and 40 healthy controls, ages 1-6 years, using LEfSe (LDA score > 3) to identify differentially abundant genera.
citation: Zhang et al. 2025, BMC Pediatrics, PMID 40108561
notes: Enriched in the FA-with-malnutrition (FAM) subgroup vs healthy controls, ages 1-6 years; food allergy diagnosed by oral food challenge.

project_title: Early-life gut microbiome and egg allergy
project_description: Multicenter case-control fecal 16S rRNA gut microbiome study (CoFAR cohort) of 141 children with and without egg allergy, ages 3-16 months at enrollment, using LEfSe and logistic regression adjusted for age, atopic dermatitis score, breastfeeding, and antibiotic usage.
notes: Children ages 3-16 months at enrollment (CoFAR multicenter cohort); egg allergy diagnosed by clinical evaluation, egg-specific IgE, and skin prick test. Genus-level finding from confounder-adjusted LEfSe/logistic regression model.
